*Part of the [ASA-DahShu Master Protocol Working Group](mpwg.qmd).*

## Overview

The Operations sub-stream focuses on the practical, cross-functional, and strategic challenges of implementing master protocol trials, including sponsor models, governance, site coordination, data standards, and lessons learned from real-world deployments.

**Co-leads:** Matthew Gribben (Amgen) and Marianne Chase (Mass General Brigham)

## Current Focus Areas

- Comparing the operational and strategic profiles of company-sponsored versus non-profit/academic-sponsored master protocol trials
- Identifying best practices for cross-organizational governance of platform trials
- Site engagement, patient recruitment, and operational burden in master protocol settings

## Active Survey

The sub-stream is collecting responses on similarities and differences between pharma/biotech-sponsored and academic/non-profit-sponsored master protocols. Survey responses will support a submission to the **2026 Society for Clinical Trials (SCT) Annual Meeting**.

To participate in the survey or learn more, contact the [IDSWG Leadership Team](../join.qmd).

## Recent Publication

Wu Y, Lu C, Aregay M et al. Company Sponsored Platform Trials: Recommendations and Lessons Learned from Cross-Industry Interviews. *Therapeutic Innovation and Regulatory Science* (2025). [doi:10.1007/s43441-025-00792-0](https://doi.org/10.1007/s43441-025-00792-0)
